segments.name: Commercial Banking
segments.description: Makes loans to and generates deposits from individuals and businesses while offering a wide array of general financial services.
segments.evidence: The commercial banking business segment makes loans to and generates deposits from individuals and businesses, while offering a wide array of general financial services to its customers.

segments.name: Mortgage Banking
segments.description: Division of the Bank that focused on residential mortgage origination and sales activities; sold in March 2025.
segments.evidence: The mortgage banking segment, a division of the Bank that operated as Monarch Mortgage, focused on residential mortgage origination and sales activities.

segments.name: Holding Company Activities
segments.description: Parent-level activities primarily associated with investments, borrowings, and certain noninterest expenses.
segments.evidence: Activities at the holding company or parent level are primarily associated with investments, borrowings, and certain noninterest expenses.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns primarily interest income from lending, plus investment income, deposit and lending transaction and fee income, and wealth and trust management fees paid by customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's primary source of revenue is interest income from its lending activities.

changes.text: In March 2025 the Company sold its mortgage division operating as Monarch Mortgage, exiting the mortgage banking segment's operations.
changes.evidence: On March 27, 2025, the Company completed the sale of its mortgage division operating as Monarch Mortgage.

changes.text: During 2024 the Company exited its banking-as-a-service depository operations through an orderly wind down of fintech partnerships.
changes.evidence: During 2024, the Company, through an orderly wind down, exited its BaaS depository operations; therefore, as of December 31, 2025, the Company had no active end-users attained through fintech channels.
